zytglogge.name: Zytglogge
zytglogge.slogan: Bern's clock tower, still chiming the hour on every quarter-turn of the day.
zytglogge.line: Built around 1218–1220 as a western gate tower, its astronomical clockwork was rebuilt by Kaspar Brunner in 1527–30.

bernermuenster.name: Bern Minster
bernermuenster.slogan: Switzerland's tallest spire, and the Aare loop spread out below it.
bernermuenster.line: Begun on 11 March 1421, its tower was only finished in 1893, reaching 100.6 metres.

schilthorn.name: Schilthorn and Piz Gloria
schilthorn.slogan: A revolving restaurant at 2,970 metres, with the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau for company.
schilthorn.line: Piz Gloria was the villain's lair in the 1969 James Bond film On Her Majesty's Secret Service.

staubbach.name: Staubbach Falls
staubbach.slogan: A 297 metre veil of water falling straight into Lauterbrunnen.
staubbach.line: The soul of man resembles water.
staubbach.by: Goethe, Song of the Spirits over the Waters, 1789

chateaugruyeres.name: Gruyères Castle
chateaugruyeres.slogan: Counts' fortress on a hilltop, with the Fribourg Alps behind.
chateaugruyeres.line: Built 1270–1282, it was home to the counts of Gruyères until Count Michel's bankruptcy in 1554.
